name: recent-rain-decision-guard
requirements: An established in-ground or raised garden receiving 1.0 inch of recent rain must not return WATER TODAY or CHECK SOIL FIRST solely because modeled starting root-zone moisture is uncertain.
A current gardener soil-feel observation may override the recent-rain guard.
Containers are excluded from the recent-rain guard.
Recent rainfall must not depend on only one nearby NWS observation station when alternatives are available.
The advanced UI must allow a localized rain-gauge correction without making it a required setup step.
WAIT, CHECK SOIL FIRST, HOLD FOR RAIN, and WATER TODAY must have distinct text labels and distinct visual emphasis; color may not be the only indicator.
